review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (hybrid)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will maintain the platform underneath all of it. Partner with IT, OT, and information security on segmentation, access control, and compliance requirements for plant-connected systems. Production infrastructure-as-code experience with [Terraform / Bicep], including managing multiple environments and state responsibly.
eligibility_evidence: Candidates should be located within commuting distance of the facility or be open to relocating, with relocation assistance available.
Manage hybrid and edge footprint, including [Azure Arc] for on-premise servers and [IoT Edge / IoT Hub] where shop floor systems require local resilience and cannot depend on WAN availability.
Experience deploying into hybrid environments, not cloud-only.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Partner with IT, OT, and information security on segmentation, access control, and compliance requirements for plant-connected systems. Hands-on Azure experience across compute, networking, identity, data services, and monitoring. Azure DevOps expertise — YAML pipelines, self-hosted agents, environments and approvals, artifact management, and repository governance.
